span.p:
Planner Node
- Decompose complex queries
- Generate sub-tasks
- Set max iterations (e.g., 3)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Retriever Node
- Calls Fusion Retrieval
- Fetches relevant chunks

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Tool Node
- Calls MCP Server
- Executes functions (SQL/Calc)

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Reasoner Node (Chain-of-Thought)
- Step-by-step reasoning
- Generates Thought and Action
- Tracks intermediate steps

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Verifier Node
- Checks citations vs retrieved chunks
- Validates tool outputs
- Produces confidence score (0-1)

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Hallucination / Confidence Check
Score greater than 0.7?

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Self-Correction Node
- Feeds error back to Reasoner
- Prompts corrective action
- Increments correction counter

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Synthesizer Node
- Formats final response
- Attaches citations and sources
- Adds reasoning trace (optional)
